label: Early copy steps (outputs 2-4) of long sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires during the original phase or on the <DEL> step. Activity is concentrated on the 2nd-4th copy outputs (recall_idx 1-3; recall_idx 2 alone holds about 49% of the mass) and grows strongly with sequence length: L=9 holds 73% of the mass, L=8 21%, and it is essentially silent for L<=6. A smaller secondary bump appears on the last two outputs of L=9 sequences (recall_idx 7-8, about 9% of mass). Within those positions it depends on the token: it fires more on inputs i, v, 2, p and x, and more often when the sequence contains more digits. However, no simple token set improves F1, so precision stays near 0.46. Top activations are typically on the 2nd copied token (e.g. v or p at recall_idx 2) of L=9 sequences. The predicate captures about 81% of activation mass at dev F1 0.56.
